csr-0001.name: Common Solution Register Demonstrator
csr-0001.last_valid:
# solution.yml: describes the Common Solution Register Demonstrator as a common
# solution (record csr-0001). Schema: schema/asset.schema.json.
# The codebase that implements it is described by publiccode.yml.
schema_version: "0.1"
id: csr-0001
record_status: owner-confirmed
name: Common Solution Register Demonstrator
summary: >-
  A working demonstrator of a common solution register for the Scottish public
  sector, built for the short-life working group to react to.
purpose: >-
  Shows how public bodies in Scotland could describe the solutions they offer to
  each other for reuse, and how those descriptions could be validated, published
  and kept current. It lets members of the short-life working
  group on a common solution register search and browse example records, draft
  and validate a solution.yml, and see owner-hosted records harvested. It is not
  an official register. Whichever body the working group asks to take the work
  forward can adopt the repository, by transfer or fork, and build on it.
asset_type: service
owner:
  organisation: The Digital Office for Scottish Local Government
  sector: local-government
contact:
  type: role-mailbox
  value: solution-register@digitaloffice.scot
service_areas:
  - administration-and-government
capabilities:
  - content-and-publishing
  - data-and-analytics
  - collaboration-and-productivity
status: in-development
intended_adopters:
  - scottish-government
  - executive-agencies
  - local-government
  - nhs-scotland
  - police-and-fire
  - non-departmental-public-bodies
  - further-and-higher-education
terms_of_use:
  type: open-licence
  licence: MIT AND OGL-UK-3.0
  summary: Code under the MIT licence; records and documentation under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
adoption_route:
  summary: >-
    Transfer or fork the repository, change site.toml and the repository
    settings for the new host, and publish the site with GitHub Pages.
charging:
  applies: false
documentation_url: https://github.com/The-Digital-Office/common-solution-register#readme
codebases:
  - repository_url: https://github.com/The-Digital-Office/common-solution-register
    visibility: public
    publiccode_url: https://github.com/The-Digital-Office/common-solution-register/raw/main/publiccode.yml
    maintenance: internal
    kind: implementation
    role: Register site, API and tools
open_data:
  - title: Register records (register.json and register.csv)
    url: https://the-digital-office.github.io/common-solution-register/data/
    catalogue: This register's Data and API page
confirmation:
  last_confirmed: "2026-11-02"
  method: owner-hosted solution.yml
  reference: https://github.com/The-Digital-Office/common-solution-register/blob/main/solution.yml
